player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} achi. Ami 15-Puzzle khelatachi.
Khelar uddeshya 1 theke 15 porjonto sankhya wala tiles ke urdhobhag kora, ebong khali jaygata niche-dakshin kona te rakha.
Ekti chal khorte, tumi khali jaygata te (double underscore, jemon __) ekti tile slide korte paro, nimnolikhito command gulo bapare:
- 'up': Khali jaygata niche thaka tile ta upore uthao.
- 'down': Khali jaygata upore thaka tile ta niche namao.
- 'left': Khali jaygata danpashe thaka tile ta bam pashe chao.
- 'right': Khali jaygata bam pashe thaka tile ta dan pashe chao.
Tomar chal joma dite, disha (jemon, 'up', 'down', 'left', ba 'right') ke square brackets e, jemon [up] lekho.
Bartamane board layout niche dekhano ache. Ei sohojog gulo bapare puzzle ta solve koro.
